Dealers and distributors: add professional leak detection to your range.

Jacob's MC works with retailers, resellers and distributors who supply contractors, plumbers, utilities and other professionals. In the US, plumbers typically charge $300–$1,300 for a single leak detection: a service they can bill on its own, with equipment you supply.

The range: a tracer gas detector that pinpoints leaks in 30 minutes or less, even under a concrete slab; a highly sensitive acoustic detector with noise filters; and a 2-in-1 platform with both technologies. Also available: a Full HD pipe inspection camera and an under-floor drying system.

Easy to sell and easy to support: no training needed, no calibration or service plan, a 1-year manufacturer warranty with most issues resolved by phone, and dispatch within 24 hours on business days. Manufactured in Lithuania (EU), CE marked, used in more than 40 countries.

DM us "DEALER" or apply at jacobs-mc.co/dealer.
